subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on BMW engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the B38 across all 3 model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The B38 is BMW's entry-level three-cylinder petrol engine, fitted across the 1 Series, X1 and X2 — three of the more straightforward applications in our workshop.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild, with all ancillary systems inspected and measured during the process.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: No widely-reported pattern is confirmed for the B38 across any of its three applications. We don't treat this engine as having one universal failure mode; diagnosis is required to establish whether an engine needs repair, rebuild or replacement.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed B38 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.
